# P2a performance addendum: test ownership cleanup

**PASS for static performance equivalence**, source
`7e3f72ebfaef39d6e6630dd11fa7dc91c8985d4a`. No blocking performance finding.

Independently verified all 4,743 actual source paths and hashes, the direct
parent `a418947fcacd49c259a83cfc7c9a7c640552117c`, tracked index and clean status
against the current fixed seven-pattern snapshot. The source path set is
unchanged. All 4,742 other source files are byte-identical to the reviewed merge.
The one test-file change is exactly removal of `.clone()` from the fixture-value
assignment in `absent_observation_round_trip_does_not_become_bare_null`.
Whole-file equality to that single replacement proves all 30 test declarations,
mutations and assertions are preserved, including the later required project
clone used for decoding. No test is removed, skipped or weakened.

Production identity capture, the Rust decoder and its tree-map index, Gradle
bridge, parallel-sync policy, model lifecycle and UI callers are unchanged.
The earlier static performance findings and limitations therefore carry forward.
In particular, catalogue/Basic-module matching remains O(P log P + M log P)
comparisons plus field-byte validation; freshness identity reconstruction,
selected-module variant scans, canonical-path filesystem work and combined
stdout-budget costs remain unchanged. Moving an unused fixture value removes
one authored-test clone. No measured timing or allocation improvement is claimed.

The authorization record describes Root's explicitly bounded nonsemantic
ownership cleanup after the user-facing three-semantic-round escalation. It
records no new user approval reply; this review adds no semantic fix round and
makes no authorization decision beyond its assigned review scope.

The earlier actual strict-Clippy failure log and independent quality FAIL review
are preserved and hash-bound in the companion JSON. This performance PASS does
not turn those failures into passes. Corrected-source all-feature/component,
Clippy, UI, actual Gradle/SDK oracle, full-app/native and lead-CI gates remain
pending for this addendum. Earlier executions retain their original source
attribution. No startup, hardware, peak-memory, cancellation-timing or
large-project runtime performance claim is made, and original-test parity
receives zero new credit.

This reviewer ran no Cargo, rustc, JVM, Gradle, SDK, native or application command
and changed only these two external report files. Source, cache and Git state
were unchanged; prior reviews and failure evidence were not overwritten.
